text: The Fruitist, the premium berry brand on D.C. United's shirt sleeve, is the brand of Agrovision Corp., a Los Angeles-based superfruit producer that renamed itself Fruitist in 2025.
short: The Fruitist brand belongs to Agrovision Corp., renamed Fruitist in 2025.

source.name: D.C. United – 'D.C. United Announce The Fruitist as the Club's Official Sleeve Patch Partner'
source.quote: is the dream of Agrovision Corp, one of the world’s leading and fastest growing producers and year-round suppliers of superfruits

additionalSources.name: AgFunderNews – 'Agrovision rebrands as Fruitist, notched up sales of $400m in past 12 months after meteoric growth'
additionalSources.quote: Superfruit specialist Agrovision has rebranded as Fruitist to align with its consumer brand of the same name
